visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a broad domed dog head whose bottom edge forms two long ear lobes around a chin lobe, with inner ear lines rising from the notches and a nose dot, mirrored as in the reference. A taller SQUARE candidate passed but was narrower than the reference's broad head. The rejected drawing had two eye dots and a W-shaped bottom that read as a face mask.
omissions: The reference's two nostril dots become one nose dot (two dots 8 apart would crowd the ear lines).
